README: Simulated trial v2 (non-circular design; see README_demo_v2.md). 'tier' = tertile of latent g (oracle strata). 'U' and 'true_ATE_*' are NOT design constants: uplift is emergent. U[tier] = mean over LLM-arm participants in that g-tertile of (realised outcome with assistant) - (the same persona's counterfactual no-assistant answer on the same items, generated only for truth.json). true_ATE_sample_llm_arm_mix = that mean over the whole LLM arm; true_ATE_population is set equal to it because control-arm Y(1) is not generated. oracle_diff_in_means_by_true_g_tertile is the between-arm contrast within true-g tertiles (what E1 would give with a perfect stratifier).
outcome_definition: mean over 2 trial items of |judge-present ∩ {C1..C7}|/7 + 0.125*flags_inconsistency (est.scorer.judge_submission); secondary = |present ∩ {C3..C7}|/5
